title: Voyage and online import: clean unit suite and packaged-extension fixture verification
requirement: Fix Voyage embedding/rerank Atlas routing and add all-history imports from Claude and ChatGPT websites.

requirements.text: Voyage embeddings and reranking work with the matching Atlas endpoint.
Import all available old and recent Claude/ChatGPT conversations through signed-in sessions.
Settings and Import UI expose endpoint and all-history choices.

runtime.name: Repository Playwright Chromium extension runner
runtime.reason: User requested continued verification. Lead selected the existing repository runner for supporting fixture checks after BrowserHostUnavailable; no explicit browser preference was supplied.

context.role: Isolated test profile; site responses mocked; no live provider credentials

plan.title: Atlas embedding and rerank requests succeed
plan.method: In the built extension, use the configured Atlas model key and Test both Voyage services.
plan.expected: Both succeed against ai.mongodb.com; legacy routing remains explicit.

plan.title: Import old and recent chats from online accounts
plan.method: Sign in to Claude and ChatGPT, open Import / Export, select All history, start, observe progress, cancel and run again.
plan.expected: Older chats import beyond 500, duplicates are skipped and partial progress is kept.

plan.title: Endpoint and import controls are usable
plan.method: Inspect endpoint settings and Import controls at desktop and narrow widths.
plan.expected: Controls and destinations match the chosen host; all-history and recent import are reachable.

plan.title: Packaged extension imports old and recent chats from both mock sites
plan.method: Import recent chats; import all history including archived ChatGPT and 400-day-old Claude chats; rerun ChatGPT import.
plan.expected: Complete stored conversations, clear signed-out error, unchanged copies skipped without duplicates.

plan.title: Import controls fit a 420px side panel
plan.method: Open Import / Export in the packaged side panel at 420 by 860.
plan.expected: All-history selector and start button remain usable with no horizontal overflow.
